notes: Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority admitted provider-free read-only failure-coordinate diagnosis after the accepted attempt-006 terminal.
The diagnosis named no Docker object, created no object, started no PostgreSQL process and made no provider request.
The successor is a provider-free static source conformance repair; attempt 007 remains unauthorised.

decisions.summary: Accept the closed cli_option_surface_mismatch coordinate: Docker start advertises attach and interactive but not the exact sig-proxy option supplied by the current harness.

Accept exact source, immutable attempt-006 projection and two read-only CLI metadata readings as sufficient to explain the created-state host-process failure without a Docker object or database rerun.
Accept removal of the unsupported sig-proxy start argument as the narrowest future repair surface, subject to separate deterministic signal, attachment, stdin and cleanup conformance.
Accept 58 current postterminal and lineage tests plus Ruff, compile, schema and canonical evidence validation; consumed preterminal assertions are not current terminal tests.
Accept that clockwork prevented an expensive retry and causal overclaim while one lifecycle-aware validation-manifest improvement remains.

claim_scope: The installed Docker start option surface does not advertise the sig-proxy option supplied by the exact harness argv.
The unsupported option explains a nonzero host process with the captured OCI server remaining created and not running.
Two fixed read-only Docker metadata commands named zero objects and created zero objects.
No PostgreSQL process, SQL/database attempt, provider request, product effect or ordinary admission occurred.
Attempts 001 through 006 and the accepted database harness remain immutable.
The smallest future repair removes one unsupported argv token and requires deterministic signal, attachment, stdin and cleanup conformance.
Attempt 007 remains unauthorised and requires separate accepted repair, plan, receipt and checkpoint.
Clockwork replaced a blind occupied retry with one typed read-only reading.
unresolved_gates: The unsupported sig-proxy start argument remains in the database harness until a separately accepted repair changes it.
Default signal forwarding plus attachment, stdin and cleanup semantics after token removal remain to be proved deterministically.
No attempt 007 or further disposable PostgreSQL execution is authorised.
Rollback, unknown-response commit and authoritative readback remain unproved.
Dedicated check-in remains default-off without ordinary-practice admission.
No provider, product-data, production, deployment, release, Pages or protected integration is open.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A postterminal diagnosis validation manifest must select current-lifecycle tests and exclude preterminal empty-namespace or historical exact-hash assertions that are intentionally false after accepted descendants.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first broad selection included two consumed-attempt preterminal tests and one earlier repair-plan exact-hash assertion, producing three lifecycle-inapplicable failures.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pytest failed before closeout publication; each failure was traced to an explicitly consumed terminal or accepted later harness digest rather than the diagnosis candidate.

correction.action: Replace the broad mixed selection with a current postterminal and descendant-compatible 58-test manifest.
correction.prevention_control: Generate future validation manifests from terminal-state and artifact-lifecycle tags instead of filename adjacency.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects mixed preterminal/postterminal validation selection without another occupied run.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Postterminal tests must reject dynamic raw values while admitting safe typed placeholders and must compare document semantics independently of incidental Markdown capitalization.

correction.action: Assert prohibited raw field names instead of safe typed placeholders and normalize report case before semantic comparison.
